'''Karson's Park''' was a beautiful park located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]].

==Description==
It had many attractions, such as a large pond in which [[greenbeak]]s swam. A small wood with walking paths. Picnic tables and benches were placed throughout. There were even public athletic courts. They were cracked and worn, but usable. These athletic courts were where local youth met and played. People also enjoyed buying [[sweet ice]] to eat. They would also buy processed feed from [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droids]] that cleaned the park. The people would then feed the greenbeaks.

==History==
[[Zeerid Korr]] went to Karson's Park to meet his daughter, [[Arra Yooms]], and his sister-in-law, [[Natala Yooms]]. Arra fed the greenbeaks and then chased them around after getting her [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|hoverchair]].
Zeerid was being followed by a man named [[Vrath Xizor]] while at the park. Zeerid was suspicious of him, but Vrath told Zeerid he was just watching the greenbeaks.
